name: Delicate Instruments
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
